note: Burned-in publisher copy on an otherwise usable frame. `acknowledges` names a segment whose unclean tag this boundary already accounts for: beat 49 is a long clean shot that dissolves into the logo card in its final seconds, so it is tagged unclean as a whole while only its tail is, and the 163.6s cut removes exactly that tail. no build may paint over any other unclean beat. Boxes are in source pixels at 1920x1080 and windows are source seconds, so a redaction survives any later re-encode of the same source. Only non-diegetic text is covered: the Vex glyphs in the ruins are in-fiction and stay. All three cards here fill the whole frame, so their action is 'cut' -- the video starts and ends on picture rather than opening or closing on a painted black rectangle. The two logo records share one window; the union of cut windows is what sets the kept range.
